answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ivory of the next round. The vault of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
